points.title: 出生地
points.description: 德米特里·门捷列夫于1834年出生于俄罗斯西伯利亚的托博尔斯克。他的家庭背景和早期教育为他后来的科学成就奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Dmitrii Mendeleev was born in Tobolsk, Siberia, Russia, in 1834. His family background and early education laid the foundation for his later scientific achievements.

points.title: 大学学习
points.description: 1859年至1860年，门捷列夫在圣彼得堡大学学习，期间对化学产生了浓厚的兴趣。他在这里完成了他的化学学位，并开始了他的科学职业生涯。
points.descriptionEn: Between 1859 and 1860, Mendeleev studied at St. Petersburg University, where he developed a keen interest in chemistry. Here, he completed his chemistry degree and began his scientific career.

points.title: 元素周期表的发明
points.description: 1869年，门捷列夫在圣彼得堡发表了元素周期表，这是他最著名的成就。他根据元素的原子量和化学性质，将元素进行了分类，并预测了尚未发现的元素。
points.descriptionEn: In 1869, Mendeleev published the periodic table in St. Petersburg, his most famous achievement. He classified elements based on their atomic weight and chemical properties, and predicted the existence of yet undiscovered elements.

points.title: 圣彼得堡大学教授
points.description: 1871年，门捷列夫成为圣彼得堡大学的教授，并继续他的科学研究。他在这里教授化学，并继续发展他的元素周期表理论。
points.descriptionEn: In 1871, Mendeleev became a professor at St. Petersburg University and continued his scientific research. Here, he taught chemistry and continued to develop his periodic table theory.

supporter.zh: 德米特里·门捷列夫被誉为化学史上的巨人，他的元素周期表是化学领域的里程碑。他的贡献在于发现了元素周期律，并预测了新元素的存在，对化学的发展产生了深远的影响。
supporter.en: Dmitrii Mendeleev is hailed as a giant in the history of chemistry, with his periodic table being a milestone in the field of chemistry. His contribution lies in the discovery of the periodic law of elements and the prediction of the existence of new elements, which has had a profound impact on the development of chemistry.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为，尽管门捷列夫的元素周期表具有革命性，但它也存在一些局限性，如对某些元素分类的不准确。此外，他的理论在后来的化学发展中并未得到完全的证实。
critic.en: Some critics argue that, while Mendeleev's periodic table was revolutionary, it also had limitations, such as inaccuracies in the classification of certain elements. Moreover, his theory was not fully confirmed in the subsequent development of chemistry.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，门捷列夫被视为现代化学的奠基人之一。他的元素周期表不仅是一种分类工具，也是一种科学理论，对化学的发展产生了深远的影响。在大众文化中，他通常被描绘为一个具有远见卓识的科学家。
objective.en: In the academic community, Mendeleev is regarded as one of the founders of modern chemistry. His periodic table is not only a classification tool but also a scientific theory, which has had a profound impact on the development of chemistry. In popular culture, he is often portrayed as a visionary scientist.

self.zh: 元素周期律是自然界的一个基本法则。
self.en: The periodic law is a fundamental law of nature.

others.zh: 门捷列夫的元素周期表是化学史上最伟大的发现之一。
others.en: Mendeleev's periodic table is one of the greatest discoveries in the history of chemistry.
